<thought>Search the template catalog for a retrosynthetic template that, in the forward direction, breaks an aliphatic carboxylic acid and forms an amide (C–N bond formed, C–O bond broken). This matches the described transformation.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
    "molecule_smiles": "Cc1ccc(NS(=O)(=O)c2ccc(/C=C/C(=O)Nc3ccccc3N)cc2)cc1",
    "functional_groups_broken": ["aliphatic carboxylic acid"],
    "functional_groups_formed": ["amide"],
    "bonds_formed": ["C-N"],
    "bonds_broken": ["C-O"],
    "limit": 5
}</action_input>
